title: SCOPE: Spatial Coastal Operations and Processing Engine
description: SCOPE is a QGIS plugin that generates model-ready grid files for the process-based coastal models XBeach and AeoLiS from raster bathymetry and vector polygon layers. Users draw and rotate a model domain on the QGIS map canvas, and SCOPE interpolates the elevation data onto uniform or threshold-driven adaptive grids, derives parameter grids such as vegetation density, hard layers or bed friction from polygon layers, and writes complex-valued threshold mask grids for AeoLiS.
